function inactive() {}
console.log(inactive.caller, inactive.arguments);
console.log(Object.getOwnPropertyNames(Function.prototype).join(','));
console.log(Object.getOwnPropertyNames(inactive).join(','));
for (const name of ['caller', 'arguments']) {
  const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Function.prototype, name)!;
  console.log(name, descriptor.configurable, descriptor.enumerable, descriptor.get!.name, descriptor.set!.name);
  descriptor.set!.call(inactive, 42);
  console.log(descriptor.get!.call(inactive), Object.hasOwn(inactive, name));
}
function active(first: string, second?: string) {
  const before = active.arguments;
  const caller = active.caller;
  console.log(caller?.name ?? null, before, before === active.arguments, before.callee === active);
  first = 'changed';
  if (second !== undefined) arguments[1] = 'changed';
  console.log(active.arguments, arguments);
}
function direct() { active('a', 'b'); }
function byCall() { active.call(undefined, 'c'); }
function byApply() { active.apply(undefined, ['d']); }
function byBind() { active.bind(undefined, 'e')(); }
function strictCaller() { 'use strict'; active('f'); }
function callbackBoundary() { ['g'].forEach((value, index) => active(value + String(index))); }
function builtinBoundary() { ['h'].forEach(active as (value: string) => void); }
direct();
byCall();
byApply();
byBind();
strictCaller();
callbackBoundary();
builtinBoundary();
function defaults(value = 1, ...rest: number[]) {
  console.log(defaults.arguments, Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(defaults.arguments, 'callee')!.configurable);
}
defaults(undefined, 2, 3);
const method = { run() {} }.run;
function strict() { 'use strict'; }
for (const value of [strict, () => {}, method, inactive.bind(undefined), Object, Function.prototype]) {
  for (const name of ['caller', 'arguments']) {
    const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Function.prototype, name)!;
    try {
      descriptor.get!.call(value);
    } catch (error) {
      console.log((error as TypeError).message);
    }
  }
}
